title: CR-006 Held Light — Multi-Reference Fragrance Editorial
description: Two-reference contemporary luxury fragrance campaign photograph: recognizable CR-001 fashion subject holding the CR-003 faceted perfume flacon in one coherent editorial exposure. Symbolic references only; operator must attach both verified PNGs at generation time. See docs/CR_006_HELD_LIGHT.md. No gallery image attached.

semantic_spec.request: Create a contemporary unbranded luxury fragrance campaign photograph that combines two references into one coherent editorial exposure: the recognizable adult fashion subject from the fashion-subject reference and the faceted transparent perfume flacon from the product-artifact reference. Show a three-quarter fashion portrait with enough gown construction visible, the model naturally holding or presenting one perfume bottle at a believable hand-held flacon scale so glass facets and the brushed-metal cap remain clearly readable. Preserve facial appearance, hair styling, and champagne satin gown identity from the fashion-subject reference while allowing arm and hand positioning to adapt for secure product contact. Preserve flacon silhouette, facet planes, transparent optical glass, and cap-to-bottle geometry from the product-artifact reference without importing its limestone plinth or still-life studio set. Soft controlled editorial lighting must serve satin, skin, glass, and brushed metal together under shared perspective and shadows. No logos, brand names, invented lettering, oversized advertising bottle, floating product, fused glass-into-skin, extra hands, or pasted multi-image collage.

director.moment: a quiet settled fragrance-campaign beat after the model lifts the flacon into presentation, cloth and hands already resolved
director.action: standing or lightly poised three-quarter fashion stance while one hand securely holds or presents the perfume flacon near the torso; the free hand may rest naturally without competing props
director.gaze: toward camera with calm unsmiling editorial focus appropriate to luxury fragrance advertising
director.body_weight: stable three-quarter fashion balance; torso upright enough to keep bodice architecture readable while the holding arm supports the flacon without strain
director.hand_logic: exact source hand poses are not required; fingers wrap the flacon neck or lower body with believable contact pressure, no extra fingers, no glass fused into skin or satin, and no floating bottle
director.fabric_response: champagne satin shows continuous specular ribbons along fold crowns and cowl drapery; cloth may shift slightly with the holding gesture while preserving gown construction identity
director.prop_interaction: exactly one perfume flacon from the product-artifact reference, held at hand-scale rather than oversized advertising-object scale; no limestone plinth, no second bottle, no brand tags
director.foreground: held flacon readable in front of or beside the bodice with soft contact cues at the fingers and a narrow studio floor or architectural plane if visible
director.midground: fashion subject and gown reading as one vertical editorial figure integrated with the held product under shared perspective
director.background: warm-neutral restrained architectural studio or quiet cyclorama with controlled negative space; do not import the CR-003 limestone plinth set as scene geometry
director.camera: eye-level three-quarter fashion-campaign frame showing face, cowl and bodice construction, and the held flacon with clear facet and cap readability
director.light_source: soft directional editorial key from camera-left at chest height with gentle fill, plus restrained graduated reflections that define glass facet edges and brushed-metal cap grain without uncontrolled glare washing the facets; satin, skin, glass, and metal share one coherent lighting logic
director.material_response: satin directional specular ribbons; matte-to-soft skin; transparent faceted glass with readable thickness and controlled edge definition rather than opaque crystal; brushed-metal cap with elongated grain highlights rather than polished chrome blowouts; shared shadows and perspective across person and product
director.micro_story: held light—a quiet unbranded fragrance campaign certainty in one photographic breath
